title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
LISA S. BLATT
(202) 434-5050
lblatt@wc.com



October 22, 2025

Via U.S. Mail and Electronic Filing
Hon. Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, N.E.
Washington, DC 20543

Re: Hunter v. United States, No. 24-1063
Dear Mr. Harris,
I represent the petitioner in the above-captioned matter.  I write to request an extension of
time to file the briefs as follows:
Brief for petitioner:    December 4, 2025
Brief for respondent:    January 14, 2026
Both sides agree to this schedule, which would allow the case to be heard during the
Court’s February sitting.
 Sincerely,


Lisa S. Blatt


CC: D. John Sauer, counsel for respondent
